Noah (CSM): Quick sync — finalizing the QBR deck for BeaconLabs. Need: 1) one-line exec ask, 2) updated onboarding status slide, 3) renewal-risk heatmap entry. Can we lock by tomorrow noon?

Priya (Enablement): I can own onboarding status. Current blocker: data pipeline ingest delayed by 2 weeks. Ill add remediation steps and proposed office hours.

Jules (Eng): Noted on ingest. We pushed a hotfix yesterday; ETA for full catch-up job is 48h. Ill paste pipeline logs snippet into the slide notes.

Lena (CS Ops): For the heatmap: BeaconLabs sits at amber (usage drop -20% m/m). Add proposed mitigation = targeted workshop + success metric (30d embed activation). Owner: Priya.

Mateo (Product): Exec one-liner suggestion: "Secure continued adoption by accelerating data onboarding and demonstrating measurable embed value." Shorten if needed.

Noah (CSM): Love it. Shorten to: "Accelerate onboarding to prove embed ROI." Good?

Mateo (Product): Good.

Priya (Enablement): For the workshop I propose: 1x 60-min intro, 1x 90-min hands-on, plus templates. Will draft slides and a checklist. Owner = Priya, due = next Wed.

Jules (Eng): Adding perf blurb: p95 inference latency steady at ~420ms on dedicated pool; weve trimmed tail with cache tuning. Will include a simple before/after bullet.

Lena (CS Ops): Canary/fallback note: if region ingestion lag > 6h, route to backup import and flag CSM. Ill add a one-line incident playbook link.

runbook-bot: FYI: QBR template updated with new heatmap table - https://runbook.internal/qbr-heatmap-template

Noah (CSM): Action item rollup (paste into deck notes):
```
- Priya: Workshop slides + adoption checklist (due next Wed)
- Jules: Pipeline logs + perf bullets (due EOD tomorrow)
- Lena: Heatmap + incident playone-liner (due noon tomorrow)
- Mateo: Exec one-liner confirmed (done)
- Noah: Final deck + schedule exec dry run (due tomorrow 3pm PT)
```

Mateo (Product): Can we do dry run tomorrow 3pm PT? Execs available at 3:30pm otherwise.

Noah (CSM): 3pm PT works for me. Requesting Lena and Priya to attend.

Lena (CS Ops): Ill be there.

Priya (Enablement): Ill join and run through the workshop ask.

Jules (Eng): I can join first 10 mins for the perf slide.

Noah (CSM): Post-QBR follow-ups: use this tracker and tag #beaconlabs: https://docs.internal/qbr-actions. Please add any customer feedback items with owner and expected close date.

Priya (Enablement): Will add a post-workshop adoption pulse (7/30 and 8/13).

Noah (CSM): Great work team. Ill consolidate slides after dry run and post final link here. :sparkles:
